title: The owner feedback log closes, cleans and lists its own items
why: hooks/feedback_guard.py's Stop check made the retrospective session carry 17 settled standing ids in its handoff; its remedy names only the handoff, never [closed]. That session's log held 126 items (57 rulings and 9 standing still open), none closed by a tool; it closed them by hand at 10:17 CST Nov 11. Owner 10:16 CST: "this should've been a trigger for something that should've been mechanizable" and "it's execution was a little half baked in that it's never cleaned up after or tended to". The coordinator's inbox guard also refused its reports at 09:3x and 10:0x CST on homes it could have resolved (a plan path, a step file not yet fetched).
note: Ruling R27 (owner 10:16 CST, relayed 10:18 CST; plan 6e0c790 under item 3.14 (moved from 3.6 by plan 7e04144, 10:52 CST), beside R16 and R24). Parts: (1) a ruling or task item closes itself when its home holds it on main, in the rewrite that marks repeats; (2) each refusal names [closed] as a way out (R24, step refusal-names-way-out); (3) the compaction reminder lists only items that still need work; (4) owner words from the question box or a relay are saved like a typed message. Home: decision owner-feedback-inbox. Stage 3. R28 (10:19 CST): this step is the first user of step prose-tending-contract and waits on it. Second in lane prose-tending-contract (coordinator 13:10 CST Nov 12).
source: owner 2026-11-11 10:16 CST, relayed by the retrospective session
